question: NITI Aayog, in partnership with the Institute of Competitiveness, released the _______ Export Preparedness Index (EPI) in August 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**first**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog** released the **First** **Export Preparedness Index (EPI)** in **August 2020** with the **partnership **of the **Institute of Competitiveness**.
 
• EPI is the **first-ever** report of the **Indian states** to examine the **performance and export preparedness** of the states.
 
• EPI is a **data-driven** effort to identify the **core areas crucial** for **export promotion**.
 
• **Gujarat **topped the index with a score of **75.14**.
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir** ranked last with a score of **12.27**.
 
• EPI with the report** intends** to:
 
 
• **Identify challenges and opportunities**
 
• **Enhance the effectiveness of government policies, and**
 
• **Encourage a facilitative regulatory framework**.
 
 
 
• The Structure of EPI includes 4 Pillars:
 
 
• **Policy: **Trade policy will provide a strategic direction for exports and imports
 
• **Business Ecosystem **will assist the states to attract investments and create an infrastructure to initiate start-up for individuals
 
• **Export Ecosystem** will help to assess the business environment
 
• **Export Performance** is an output-based pillar and will examine the reach of export footprints of States and Union Territories of India.
 
 
 
• EPI has 11 sub pillars:
 
 
• **Export Promotion Policy,**
 
• **Institutional Framework,**
 
• **Business Environment,**
 
• **Infrastructure,**
 
• **Transport Connectivity,**
 
• **Access to Finance,**
 
• **Export Infrastructure,**
 
• **Trade Support,**
 
• **R&D Infrastructure,**
 
• **Export Diversification, and**
 
• **Growth Orientation**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu** were top 3 among the **"Coastal states"** category.
 
• **Rajasthan** was the best performer among the **"landlocked states"** category followed by **Telangana and Haryana**
 
• **Uttarakhand** was the best performer among the **"Himalayan states"** followed by **Tripura and Himachal Pradesh**.
 
• **Delhi **scored the best among the **Union Territories**.
 
• **NITI Aayog** formed on **1st January 2015**
 
 
• Chairperson: **Narendra Modi**
 
• Vice-ChairPerson: **Rajiv Kumar**
 
• CEO: **Amitabh Kant**
